name: NZBGeek
description: Search NZBGeek for anime episodes, batches, and movies via the Newznab API.

apikey.description: Your NZBGeek API key. Find it at nzbgeek.info → Account → API Settings.

baseUrl.description: API base URL. Override only if NZBGeek changes their endpoint.

category.description: Comma-separated Newznab category IDs to search. 5070 = Anime.

name: Nyaa
description: Search Nyaa.si directly via its RSS feed — anime torrents with infoHash extraction.

domain.description: Nyaa base URL. Override to use a mirror (e.g. https://nyaa.land) if nyaa.si is blocked.

category.description: Nyaa category. 1_2 = Anime English-translated, 1_3 = Non-English, 1_4 = Raw, 0_0 = All.

filter.description: Quality filter. 0 = no filter, 1 = no remakes, 2 = trusted only.

appendResolution.description: Include the requested resolution (e.g. 1080p) in the search query when available.
